Job description
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you initiate and coordinate all project phases: from the concept and development phase to the commissioning. 
 

● 
 You are responsible for monitoring and managing the project costs, and for the planning of the project resources. 
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you negotiate with the site owners and network operators and maintain close contacts with local administrations, policy makers and all stakeholders involved. 
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you prepare investment decisions and assist in the negotiations with the parties involved. 
 

● 
 You streamline communication with other parties such as architects, engineers, site managers and the finance department. 
 

● 
 As a Project Delivery Lead you closely follow the project planning, make adjustments where necessary, and report on the project progress and the milestones. 

Your profile 
 

● 
 You have a Master degree in Engineering (Industrial, Civil, …) or equivalent level of education. 
 

● 
 You have relevant experience in project management, preferably 
in Hydrogen, Renewable Energy or similar industries. 
 

● 
 You are passionate about Hydrogen, Renewable Energy and/or environmental technologies. 
 

● 
 You have strong coordinating skills and are able of successfully managing all parties involved. 
 

● 
 Excellent knowledge of English, and able to communicate in Dutch and/or French. 
 

● 
 You are communicative, have strong people skills and can take initiative.

Your main responsibilities:

• Primary point of contact for key customers across the EMEA region, driving customer satisfaction and service excellence.

• Managed end-to-end customer order fulfillment, ensuring a seamless customer experience and proactive communication.

• Built strong relationships with customers and internal stakeholders to align on product availability, commercial terms, and business priorities.

• Proactively identified service improvement opportunities and implemented customer-centric solutions.

• Coordinated closely with Sales, Product Management, Supply Chain, and external partners to ensure high service levels.

• Monitored order performance, managed exceptions, and maintained transparent communication with customers.

• Deliver support in a fast-paced international environment, balancing customer expectations with business objectives.

• At least 2 years of experience in logistics

• Fluent in English, any additional language is an asset

• A can-do attitude is an important asset to take up additional responsibilities and to develop your skills. ‘No day in the office is the same

Join imec’s center of excellence for hardware-software-technology co-design to architect and design the future of technology-aware compute systems.
 

Compute System Architecture (CSA) is a center of excellence at imec for hardware-software-technology co-design for future compute systems. We work in close collaboration with other expertise centers in imec specializing in applications, technology, circuits and design to innovate and pathfind next-generation compute system architectures across multiple domains – AI, HPC, Automotive, Space, and more. CSA has presence in 6 centers of IMEC, in Belgium, Netherlands, Germany, UK, USA and Qatar. This position is primarily for Leuven, Belgium. 
 

We are looking for a Virtual Platform R&D Engineer to develop, enable, and maintain our baseline platform across functional models, RTL prototyping, and simulation environments. This role sits at the intersection of compute architecture, system software, and system modeling. 
 

What you will do
 
 

• Develop and maintain virtual platforms across both simulated, and hardware-prototyping environments. 

• Support workload mapping and enable functional models bring-up on various execution platforms such as: QEMU, gem5, RTL, FGPA. 

• Contribute to performance and functional validation across abstraction levels (ISA → RTL → FPGA). 

• Build system models that represent novel compute architectures, while balancing accuracy, execution speed, and ease of use. 

• Evaluate new architectural features, translating architectural concepts into executable platforms. 

• Contribute to project definitions and the technical scope of work (timeline, work packages, milestones, deliverables) in cooperation with senior members, if needed.  

• Supervise or assist in mentoring students when necessary.  

Who you are
 
 

• You hold a Master’s or PhD in Electrical/Electronics/Computer Engineering/Science or other relevant domains with hands-on compute architecture systems.   

• You are passionate about computer architecture and system-level design, with a solid understanding of modern compute and memory systems, and SoC components.  

• You have a strong background in embedded systems, including toolchains (GCC/LLVM), RTOS (e.g., Zephyr), and low-level debugging.  

• You are proficient in C/C++, in bash and Python scripting.  

• You are a hands-on engineer who enjoys bringing systems to life.  

• You have experience in RISC-V-based system architecture.   

• You are open-minded, and flexible in accommodating changing priorities to support business needs.   

• You are a team player, as you will be part of a dynamic and distributed team.  

• You are fluent in English and you have strong communication skills, enabling effective collaboration across a multicultural team.

Job description
 

● As a Business Developer – Renewable Energy you‘ll be identifying, initiating and developing large & innovative Solar, Wind, EV charging infrastructure, Energy Management System (EMS) and BESS projects.

Your profile

Lead the design, development, and optimization of enterprise applications across back-end and front-end technologies. Looking for a part-time job where you can work independently and take on real responsibility?

Do you enjoy working in a refined, stylish setting, and take pride in cleanliness and order?
 

For our two charming hotels in Eeklo — Boutique Hotel Shamon and Aparthotel Acacia — we are looking for a permanent housekeeping team member who helps deliver a flawless and warm guest experience.
 

You'll join a small team where trust, independence, and responsibility are central. You'll be responsible for the overall cleanliness and thorough cleaning of the rooms and the hotel, working independently most of the time.

 

What will you do?

Are you passionate about connecting top talent with exciting career opportunities? This role combines end-to-end recruitment with operational HR support, offering variety, ownership, and direct business impact.

Client Details

Our client is a growing international professional services organization with a strong focus on people, innovation, and business growth.

Description

As a Talent Acquisition Specialist your responsibilities are:

Our client is a leading international industrial group with operations across multiple continents and an ambitious growth strategy driven by innovation and strategic investments.

To strengthen its specialist M&A Legal team, the organisation is looking to appoint a Senior Legal Counsel based in Brussels.

Jobomschrijving

As Senior Legal Counsel - M&A, you will act as lead legal adviser on high-profile international transactions.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Leading the legal execution of domestic and international acquisitions, divestitures, joint ventures and strategic investments.
• Managing complex legal due diligence exercises and coordinating specialist legal input across multiple jurisdictions.
• Drafting, reviewing and negotiating transaction documentation, including share purchase agreements, joint venture agreements, transition service agreements, NDAs and other ancillary documents.
• Advising on transaction structuring and identifying pragmatic solutions to legal and commercial risks.
• Partnering with internal stakeholders across Corporate Strategy, M&A, Finance, Treasury, Tax, HR, IT and Compliance throughout the deal lifecycle.
• Managing signing, closing and post-closing processes.
• Supporting integrations, carve-outs and corporate reorganisations following completed transactions.
• Coordinating and managing external legal counsel internationally while maintaining ownership of transaction execution.
• Advising senior management on strategic legal considerations impacting investment decisions.
• Contributing to the continuous development of the company's M&A legal function and best practices.

• Belgian Master's degree in Law.
• Approximately 8+ years of post-qualification experience in Corporate/M&A law.
• Experience gained within a leading international law firm and/or a sophisticated international in-house legal environment.
• Demonstrated experience leading complex domestic and cross-border M&A transactions.
• Excellent drafting, negotiation and project management skills.
• Strong commercial judgement and ability to translate legal complexity into practical business advice.
• Confident communicator with the ability to influence senior stakeholders.
• Fluent in English. French and/or Dutch are considered strong assets.

As an Executive Assistant, you provide high-level administrative support to senior executives, ensuring smooth coordination of agendas, meetings, travel arrangements, and confidential communication. You play a key role in maintaining efficient operations in a fast-paced and professional international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established large organization in the professional services sector. They have a strong reputation for delivering high-quality services to a global client base and are known for fostering an environment of professionalism and excellence.

Description

As an Executive Assistant your responsibilities are:

• Managing and organizing calendars, appointments, and meetings for senior executives.
• Coordinating travel arrangements, including booking flights, accommodations, and transportation.
• Preparing and editing correspondence, reports, and presentations.
• Acting as a point of contact between executives and internal/external stakeholders.
• Handling confidential information with discretion and professionalism.
• Organizing and maintaining files, records, and documentation.
• Assisting with event planning and coordination for internal and external meetings.
• Providing general administrative support to the secretarial and business support department.

A successful Executive Assistant should have:

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills with an eye for detail.
• Proficiency in office software and tools, including Microsoft Office Suite.
• Experience in managing schedules and coordinating travel arrangements.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; additional languages are a plus.
• Ability to handle sensitive information with confidentiality and professionalism.
• A proactive approach to problem-solving and flexibility in a fast-paced environment.
• Knowledge of the professional services industry is an advantage.

In this role, you will be a key partner within the HR organisation, taking ownership of the complete payroll cycle for Belgium and Luxembourg. You combine strong attention to detail with a customer-oriented mindset and actively contribute to improving HR processes.

Client Details

Our client is an international organisation contributing to innovation and sustainable solutions within the industrial sector. To strengthen their HR team, they are looking for a Payroll Officer who will ensure a smooth, accurate and high-quality payroll experience for employees and managers.

Description

As a Payroll Officer, you will be responsible for a broad range of payroll and HR administration activities:

• Managing the end-to-end payroll process for the Belux region, including onboarding, offboarding and employee changes.
• Maintaining and validating payroll data, time registrations, leave balances and absences.
• Preparing payroll payments, performing monthly controls and supporting reconciliations, year-end closing and audits.
• Ensuring accurate and timely processing of social security and legal payroll documentation.
• Preparing payroll reports and acting as a point of contact for employees, managers and internal stakeholders.
• Supporting payroll-related financial reporting processes.
• Contributing to payroll improvement initiatives and HR projects.
• Managing group and health insurance administration, including monthly follow-up and annual evaluations.
• Handling administrative processes such as A1 certificates, American Express requests and meal and eco vouchers.
• Reviewing and approving invoices according to internal control procedures.
• Collaborating closely with external payroll providers, authorities and suppliers while continuously improving processes and documentation.

• You hold a bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Accounting & Taxation or a related field.
• You have several years of payroll experience, preferably within an international environment.
• You have a strong understanding of Belgian social and tax legislation.
• You are proficient in MS Office, especially Excel. Experience with SAP HR, Workday or other payroll systems is a plus.
• You are analytical, detail-oriented and committed to delivering high-quality work.
• You have a strong service mindset and enjoy working with different stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch, French and English, both written and spoken.

• The ability to prioritize tasks and manage deadlines effectively.
• A proactive attitude and a keen eye for identifying talent.
• Fluency in French or Dutch, English is a plus.

jobs.occupation: Senior Business Analyst / Project Manager IT
jobs.description:
Our client is a leading international player operating in the retail and distribution sector, with a strong presence in multiple markets. The company provides a wide range of products and services to both professional and private customers, supported by an extensive network and a strong focus on customer experience.

As part of the IT organization, you will play a key role in analyzing, optimizing, and transforming business processes across Supply Chain and Finance domains. Acting as a strategic business partner, you will work closely with business stakeholders to understand operational challenges, identify improvement opportunities, and translate business needs into sustainable IT solutions.

Jobomschrijving

• Analyze end-to-end business processes, particularly within Supply Chain and Finance, and identify opportunities for optimization and efficiency gains.
• Partner with business stakeholders to understand challenges, define requirements, and design improved processes.
• Translate business needs into pragmatic, scalable, and sustainable SAP-based solutions.
• Challenge business requirements by proposing alternatives aligned with industry best practices and standard solutions.
• Lead or contribute to functional design activities, testing phases, implementation projects, and change initiatives.
• Coordinate collaboration between business teams, IT teams, SAP experts, and external partners to ensure successful project delivery.
• Ensure consistency and integration across SAP modules and business processes.
• Support issue resolution by providing functional expertise and a strong understanding of business impacts.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives and contribute to the evolution of the application landscape.
• Participate in roadmap definition and transformation programs, from analysis through implementation.
• Take ownership of projects or workstreams, ensuring effective planning, stakeholder alignment, and delivery.

• 5 to 10 years of experience in a Senior Business Analyst, SAP Consultant, SAP Functional Analyst, or similar role.
• Proven experience working on SAP-related projects, with strong knowledge of Supply Chain and/or Finance processes.
• Good understanding of end-to-end business processes, ideally within a retail, distribution, or complex operational environment.
• Ability to quickly understand business challenges and translate them into effective solutions.
• Strong analytical skills with the ability to structure complex topics and provide clear recommendations.
• Experience managing projects, coordinating stakeholders, and driving delivery is a strong asset.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact confidently with both business and technical audiences.
• Pragmatic, solution-oriented mindset with a strong focus on business value and results.
• Proactive, autonomous, and comfortable working in a dynamic and evolving environment.
• Fluent in English; knowledge of Dutch and/or French is considered an advantage.
• Open-minded, collaborative, and motivated by change and continuous improvement.

Our client is a well-established retail organization operating a large network of specialized stores across Belgium. With a strong focus on customer service and operational excellence, the company relies on robust IT solutions to support its stores and central services. To support ongoing growth and digital transformation initiatives, our client is looking for an IT Onsite Support to strengthen its IT team.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Onsite Support, you will play a key role in supporting both store operations and corporate services. Acting as a first point of contact for IT-related issues, you will help ensure the smooth functioning of business-critical systems while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives:

• Provide 1st and 2nd line IT support to stores and central services, primarily remotely and occasionally on-site.
• Monitor the performance and availability of Point-of-Sale (POS) systems and coordinate issue resolution with internal or external stakeholders.
• Ensure accurate ticket logging, tracking, and follow-up through the company's service desk platform.
• Contribute to the maintenance and enhancement of POS and ERP-related functionalities.
• Create, update, and maintain user documentation and operational procedures.
• Participate in the development and enrichment of the internal knowledge base.
• Identify potential risks, recurring issues, and opportunities for process improvement.
• Support testing activities and system enhancements as your expertise develops.

• Strong motivation to learn and develop expertise in business applications and IT systems.
• Hands-on, proactive mindset with a customer-focused approach.
• Ability to work collaboratively while taking ownership of assigned tasks.
• Open to feedback and continuous improvement.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics NAV / Business Central is mandatory.
• Experience within a retail environment is a plus.
• Fluent in Dutch. French & English are an advantage.
• Willing to participate in an on-call rotation system (with appropriate compensation).
• Eager to learn and grow within a dynamic team environment.

Vinçotte is the market leader in Belgium and offers objective and advisory services in inspection, certification, conformity assessment and training. Our team of over 1,500 professionals is committed to a safer and more efficient society. Our sector specialists understand the needs of customers perfectly and guide them along the way with advice and support. Aiming for results for multinationals, SMEs, self-employed persons and private persons is what makes our blood flow. We are looking for a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) to join our team in Vilvoorde.

Ready to level up your career and secure the digital world? As a Network Security Engineer (M/F/X) you’ll be the go-to expert managing our network and security infrastructure – across our campus, datacenter, and Microsoft Azure environment.

What will you do?

• Take charge of our network & security landscape, both on-prem and in the cloud (Azure).
• Provide Level 2 support for complex IT network issues.
• Dive into IT projects related to your area of expertise.
• Work autonomously in an agile setup with a clear backlog and strategic focus.
• Help improve documentation and technical guidelines.
• Detect, assess, and fix security risks – you're our digital guardian.
• Manage and fine-tune spam filters to keep our communications safe.

Experience:

• You've already rolled up your sleeves in network and firewall management — think design, setup, config, upgrades — and you know your way around operational environments.
• You’re certified in Azure, have experience with it, or you're eager to dive in and grow into a true Azure pro.
• You’re ready to become our in-house expert on Microsoft Security tools — managing, fine-tuning, and pushing them to keep cyber threats out.
• You're curious about Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and see it as a powerful tool in building fast, scalable, modern environments.
• You believe solid processes are the backbone of great IT — and you embrace ITIL best practices to keep things running smoothly and smartly.
• You hold an IT bachelor degree and have 2-3 years of relevant experience in the following domains:
• Routing & Switching: Aruba and / or Cisco
• Next-Generation Firewall (NGFW) : Fortinet, Check Point or Palo Alto
• Reverse Proxy : BlueCoat, Fortiweb or Azure Application GW
• SASE/SDWAN: CATO, Fortinet, zScaler or Pallo Alto
• Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA) CATO and / or zScaler
• Cloud Networking & Security: Azure 
• Network Access Control (802.1X Wired/Wireless, RADIUS, TACACS, Guest Portals)
• Vulnerability management: Nessus, MS Defender or Qualys
• Network Detection and Response (NDR): Darktrace 
• Extended Detection and Response (XDR): MS Defender and / or Sentinelone, 
• Spam filtering: MS Defender, Barracuda or Cisco Ironport 

Personality:

• You don’t wait around — when something’s blocking the business, you jump in and fix it fast.
• You’re all about progress: positive mindset, always learning, always improving, and staying sharp on the latest tech trends.
• Agile is your jam — you thrive in sprints, love a good retro, and believe great things happen when teams grow together.
 

Languages:

• Dutch or French? Check. English? No problem — you’re fluent in the language of international teamwork.

For a client in Duffel we are looking for a temporary 
Customer Service Representative.
 

Responsibilities
 
 

• You process customer orders accurately, efficiently, and in a timely manner, while closely following up to ensure excellent customer service. 

• You respond to customer inquiries and emails and ensure smooth communication with clients.
